title: 盖伦·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 棕色短发衬着饰有金边的厚重银甲，宝蓝披风延伸出明亮色块。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Garen is a broad adult Demacian knight with short brown hair, a square clean-shaven face, heavy silver armor, gold accents, and a royal-blue cape or scarf. Preserve his substantial natural adult proportions, oversized shoulder armor, fully covered torso and legs, gauntlets, and boots. His enormous straight broadsword rests tip-down on stone, held motionless by the pommel with no striking gesture.
art_direction.scene: A low viewpoint with a calm upward head turn, full iconic shape framed by a simple sweep of bright pencil hatching. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: royal blue, silver gray, warm gold, pale limestone; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
